description: This file defines a GUI component class 'FlexibleControls' that includes text fields, buttons, and functionality to convert human-readable expressions into RPN (Reverse Polish Notation) form using an external evaluator. It is part of a UI module for a larger Java application related to 'rusefi'.

classes.name: FlexibleControls
classes.description: A GUI component for inputting and converting algebraic expressions into RPN form within a Java Swing application.

methods.name: FlexibleControls
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GUI components, setting default expression, and adding an action listener to convert input expression to RPN.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Converts the input human-readable expression into RPN using DoubleEvaluator and updates the rpnForm text field.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel component containing all UI elements.
